title: Validate tenant-aware two-stage publication routing preparation
description:
Feature: Separate publication routing stages
Scenario: Prepare without editorial choices
Given the domain, SaaS account, publication, central grant and section criteria are not yet supplied
When an operator validates a prepared site plan
Then it remains inactive and lists unresolved fields without inventing them
Scenario: Preserve two stages and tenant provenance
Given distinct owner and consumer SaaS accounts and a consumer-owned section router
When a matched central output is handed to section routing
Then source revision, publication, central decision and owner/consumer identities are retained
And feedback and undecided labels remain separate
Scenario: Refuse implicit tenant reuse
Given central owner account differs from the publication account
When the internal router is bound to the central owner or the same central engine
Then validation rejects the plan.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented inactive publication routing preparation and guarded section handoff in publication_routing_plan.py, a Data Parade plan with all unverified identities/domain/editorial settings null, a behavior feature, synthetic unit tests and documentation. The plan preserves the existing shared central publication Cyclotron followed by the consumer's separate internal section Cyclotron. No taxonomy, match label, policy or section classification is invented.

Final root verification: 76 pytest tests, six isolated Behave scenarios/28 steps, Ruff/format, pilot identifier guard and whitespace checks pass. Full Behave loading remains unavailable in this environment because the baseline limatus.contracts dependency is missing; the actual feature and matching step file passed in isolation. Repository-wide Kanbus validation also reports 15 inherited unrelated short-ID dependency errors; new issues use full IDs and existing tracker files are untouched.

Independent review and an actual native central-decision-to-generated-sharing-receipt-to-Papyrus smoke passed. Source catalog/native revision, nullable origin publication, consumer internal ownership, original decision/billing and grant revocation are preserved; no additional model call is made. The contract is not wired into hosted runtime and creates no infrastructure or grants.
